chunks: You have indeed a noble paradigm in the Apostle of God for him who fears God and the Day of Resurrection, and remembers God frequently.

key_terms.الْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ: the Day of Resurrection / the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: Who is the ideal role model for Muslims according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to establish the Prophet's Sunnah as the primary source of legislation and spiritual guidance, complementing the Imams' role as the living interpreters of that model. It underscores that true emulation requires not just outward imitation but an internal state of hope (rajā') and constant mindfulness (dhikr) of the Divine. This establishes the Prophet as the perfect human (al-Insān al-Kāmil) whose life provides the comprehensive blueprint for both individual piety and communal governance.
